classifications.public: Visible to anyone in the tenant with access to the record type (e.g. directory names).
classifications.employee: Visible to the employee concerned and to roles granted the record type.
classifications.hr-restricted: HR, security and explicitly granted roles only.

retentionClasses.tenant-account: Life of the customer contract plus the offboarding retention period (SAS-03, SAS-04). Period: not yet decided.
retentionClasses.identity-access: Access records kept for security review after revocation. Period: not yet decided.
retentionClasses.employment-record: Personnel history retained after employment ends per the legal pack and tenant policy (NFR-05, DOC-17). Period: comes from an approved pack, none exists yet.
retentionClasses.audit-trail: Per audit category within legal minimums, with legal hold (AUD-07). Period: not yet decided.
retentionClasses.operational-transient: Delivery/processing bookkeeping; purge after completion window. Period: not yet decided.
retentionClasses.product-catalogue: Product-versioned reference data; kept while referenced.
retentionClasses.schema-metadata: Kept for the life of the database.
retentionClasses.authentication: Credentials, MFA secrets and sessions: kept while the account exists; sessions and challenges purged after expiry plus a security review window. Period: not yet decided.

entities.description: Customer tenant: the root of every isolation boundary.
entities.writePath: provision_tenant() via the platform role only.
constraints: version >= 1, must advance by exactly 1 per update
insert/update requires an audit event in the same transaction

entities.description: Legal employer inside a tenant (ORG-01). Statutory registrations (ORG-02) are later work.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant; defaults to the transaction's tenant context.

production_payroll_enabled.description: Always false until Section 20 conditions are met.

entities.description: Global sign-in identity (IAM-04). Visible to a tenant only through its own membership. Holds no profile data.
entities.writePath: membership_invite() creates or links by normalized email.
constraints: RLS: readable only when a membership in the current tenant references it

entities.description: A user's access to one tenant. State contract: docs/architecture/workflows/membership.md.
constraints: no self status change except accepting an invitation

entities.description: Product-versioned resource:action catalogue (RBAC-02). Read-only at runtime; changed only by migration.
entities.migration: Created and seeded in 0002_identity_org (expand). New permissions are added by later expand migrations; removal needs a contract migration after no role references them.

catalogue_version.description: Catalogue version that introduced the permission.

entities.description: Tenant role: a named set of permissions. System role templates (RBAC-01) are not seeded yet.
constraints: parent_role_id FK within the same tenant, not self
is_system cannot be set by runtime roles

is_system.description: Product-provided role; immutable except tenant scoping.

parent_role_id.description: Role this one was cloned from.

entities.description: Permission granted to a tenant role.
constraints: insert/delete requires an audit event for the role

entities.description: Grant of a role to a membership for a scope and a business-date interval. State contract: docs/architecture/workflows/role-assignment.md.
entities.migration: Created in 0002_identity_org (expand). Further RBAC-03 scope dimensions arrive as nullable columns in a later expand migration.
constraints: FKs to membership, role, legal_entity within the same tenant
no overlapping interval for the same membership, role and scope (exclusion constraint)
assignee cannot be the acting user (insert or update)
only effective_to and version are updatable

effective_to.description: Last business date in force, inclusive; null = open.

entities.description: Person anchor (EMP-01). Attributes live in person_version; this row holds identity and the aggregate's optimistic version.
constraints: optimistic version (bumped with every new version row)

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version of the aggregate.

entities.description: Effective-dated person attributes with recorded time (EMP-08). Append-only except closing the open version.
entities.migration: Created in 0003_people (expand). New attributes arrive as nullable columns (expand), backfilled (migrate), then made required (contract).
constraints: no overlapping intervals per person (exclusion constraint)
only an open version may be closed; closed history is immutable

effective_to.description: Last business date in force, inclusive; null = open.

birth_date.description: Date of birth (hidden in directory unless shared, HRP-01).

entities.description: Employment of a person by a legal entity (EMP-01). Rehire is a new employment row; history is preserved.
entities.migration: Created in 0003_people (expand). Employment category / classification (EMP-04) is deliberately absent pending design (open questions).
constraints: FKs to person and legal_entity within the same tenant

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version of the aggregate.

entities.description: Effective-dated employment attributes with recorded time (EMP-08).
constraints: only an open version may be closed

effective_to.description: Last business date in force, inclusive; null = open.

entities.description: Tamper-evident audit trail (AUD-01..AUD-09). Per-tenant hash chain; append-only for every role.
entities.writePath: writeAudit() inside the business transaction; provision_tenant().
entities.migration: Created in 0001_foundation (expand). Never contract: removing columns would break hash verification of existing rows; add a new hash version instead.
constraints: prev_hash = previous row hash; hash = sha256(prev_hash | canonical row)
seq, prev_hash, hash, recorded_at, txid assigned by trigger
UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE rejected for every role
category, actor_type, result, source from fixed lists

occurred_at.description: Event time reported by the application (AUD-09).

txid.description: Writing transaction; links events to the change they audit.

actor_type.description: user, service-account, system-job, support-staff or platform-operator.

source.description: web, api, mobile, integration, job or platform.

before_ref.description: Pointer/diff of prior state; restricted fields carry markers, never values (AUD-03).

after_ref.description: Pointer/diff of new state; restricted fields carry markers, never values (AUD-03).

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in the tenant chain.

hash.description: sha256 of prev_hash and canonical row content.

entities.description: Latest seq and hash per tenant chain. Not granted to runtime roles; used to serialize appends and detect a truncated tail.
Transactional outbox (ARCH-07). State contract: docs/architecture/workflows/outbox-event.md.
entities.writePath: publishEvent() in the business transaction; outbox_claim() and the worker for status.
constraints: transitions enforced by trigger; content immutable
status columns updatable by pl_worker only

id.description: Event id; also the handler idempotency key.

dedupe_key.description: Stable producer key; repeats are ignored.

payload.description: Event payload. Convention: identifiers only, no sensitive values.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id of the producing request.

entities.description: Record that an effect identified by (scope, key) has been applied. Inserted in the same transaction as the effect.

created_at.description: DB clock when the effect was applied.

entities.description: Applied migrations with checksums. Managed by the migration runner.
entities.migration: Created by the migration runner before the first migration.

entities.description: Password credential per user account (IAM-01). scrypt hash only; lockout counters (NFR-02).
TOTP authenticator per user (IAM-01). Secret encrypted with AES-256-GCM; replay blocked via last_used_step.

secret_ciphertext.description: Encrypted base32 secret (context-bound to the user).

confirmed_at.description: Set when enrolment is confirmed with a code; null = pending.

entities.description: Single-use MFA recovery codes, stored as sha256.
A password-verified sign-in awaiting MFA and/or tenant choice. Short-lived, attempt-limited.
Signed-in session for one user in one tenant (IAM-04, IAM-05). Cookie token stored as sha256; idle and absolute expiry.
constraints: FK (tenant_id, user_id) -> membership: only members can hold a session

tenant_id.description: Tenant the session is bound to.

mfa_verified.description: Second factor proved in this session.

mfa_enrollment_required.description: Privileged user without MFA: only enrolment is allowed (SEC-05).

entities.description: One-time link to set or reset a password (IAM-01 account recovery, invitation acceptance). Only the newest per user and tenant is usable.
entities.writePath: auth_issue_setup_token() from a tenant administrator; redeemed by AuthService.
constraints: cannot be issued by the user for themself

entities.description: Authentication events (AUD-01): logins, failures, lockouts, MFA, sessions, password changes. Append-only for every role. Tenant-relevant events are also written to that tenant's audit_event.
constraints: event and result from fixed lists
UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE rejected for every role
no email or password ever stored
